cases.given: A new responsive incident dashboard has no design system or visual precedent, and polished presentation is part of the outcome.
expect: Name a deliberate direction grounded in incident triage and information priority.
Apply it consistently through hierarchy, density, typography, shape, and interaction treatment.
Do not prescribe a generic palette or claim one screen establishes a product-wide system.

cases.given: A Mantine application already defines theme tokens, variants, and shared components.
expect: Preserve Mantine and project ownership instead of imposing a new greenfield direction.
Reuse semantic tokens, variants, and shared components.
Treat any local extension as a demonstrated gap at the canonical owner.

cases.given: The requested product must be polished on desktop and mobile and also has a recoverable error state.
expect: Render a representative populated state with realistic density and content lengths on desktop.
Render the same primary task separately on mobile.
Exercise a relevant interaction state and keep error or recovery evidence separate from primary-state evidence.
